* Own the performance and stability of applications and infrastructure.
* Evaluate and adopt new tools and practices that speed up delivery.

* 2–3 years of backend experience at product companies.
* CS/Engineering degree (IITs / top NITs preferred).

Responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

### **Why Work at Lenovo**

We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.  

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked \#153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full\-stack portfolio of AI\-enabled, AI\-ready, and AI\-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world\-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992\) (ADR: LNVGY).  

  

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world\-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
### **Description and Requirements**

Lenovo Solutions \& Services Group is running a company\-wide AI transformation programme, embedding engineering talent directly inside business functions. Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the builders at the center of that model.


As an FDE, you will be assigned to a specific business function and work alongside its leaders and teams to identify where AI creates real leverage, then build and deploy practical solutions that fit how work actually gets done. This is not a research or advisory role — you move from discovery to working prototype to deployed solution within sprint cycles, in close partnership with a Domain Leader who provides business direction and context.


The right candidate is energized by driving meaningful change in a business — not just shipping code, but making sure what gets built is genuinely adopted and used. You are comfortable working with typical tech stacks such as Microsoft and ServiceNow as well as building custom AI agents/ solutions on other internal platforms.

**What You Will Do**

**Discover and Define**

* Embed in a business function and work with the Domain Leader and subject matter experts to map workflows, surface pain points, and identify high\-value AI opportunities.
* Translate business problems into scoped, deliverable use cases — balancing ambition with what is practical to build and adopt.

**Build and Deploy**

* Design and build AI solutions using the right tools for the problem: Microsoft AI and productivity platforms (Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, M365\), RAG pipelines, agent workflows, automation tooling, and custom development where needed.
* Prototype quickly, test with real users, and iterate within short sprint cycles.
* Deliver solutions that integrate into existing workflows — not standalone demos.

**Drive Adoption and Impact**

* Own adoption as well as technical delivery — work alongside change resources to help teams actually use what gets built.
* Gather feedback post\-deployment to improve performance and increase business value over time.
* Contribute to patterns and practices that can scale across squads and functions.

**Communicate and Collaborate**

* Bridge business stakeholders, data teams, and platform partners — translating clearly in both directions.
* Provide concise, honest updates on progress, risks, and tradeoffs to technical and senior non\-technical audiences alike.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Required**

* 5\+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, applied AI, or a closely related technical role.
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying AI, automation, or intelligent workflow solutions in real business settings.
* Strong working knowledge of LLMs, prompt design, retrieval\-based architectures, orchestration, and agent\-based systems.
* Comfortable integrating with enterprise APIs, data sources, and workflow platforms.
* A genuine drive to see change land — you understand that building the solution is only half the job.
* Clear communicator; able to explain technical decisions in plain language to business and leadership audiences.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Microsoft AI platforms: Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, M365, Power Platform.
* Custom development skills (Python, JavaScript, or similar) for problems that off\-the\-shelf tooling cannot solve.
* Background in technical consulting, solutions architecture, or customer\-facing engineering.
* Experience with change enablement, user adoption, or process redesign alongside technical delivery.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Working solutions in users’ hands at the end of each sprint — not decks or proofs of concept.
* Measurable business outcomes: time saved, processes improved, decisions made faster.
* A team that has adopted the tools and can articulate the impact.
* A function that can operate and evolve its AI solutions after the engagement ends.

* Hands\-on experience building AI/ML systems.

* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Agentic AI / AI Agents
* Voice AI
* Multimodal AI / Multimodal Reasoning
* Ability to build and deploy **production\-grade AI systems**.
* Strong sense of ownership and ability to work independently.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, early\-stage startup environment.

**Why Join?**

* Work directly with the **founders** with no management layers in between.
* Be part of a **small founding AI engineering team**.
* Take significant technical ownership from day one.
* Build AI systems from the ground up rather than working several layers removed from the product.

*If you are an AI engineer looking for an opportunity to work closely with founders, take substantial technical ownership, and build cutting\-edge AI systems from the ground up, we would love to hear from you.*

You will design, build, and evolve AI\-based capabilities such as: Real\-time and post\-call transcription services LLM\- features (summarization, agent assist, analytics, automation) Prompt management and orchestration Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines Knowledge base ingestion and management AI\-driven workflows embedded directly into CCaaS user experiences You are expected to deeply understand product requirements, make technical decisions independently, and contribute end\-to\-end from architecture and backend services to frontend experiences. Build systems that safely and efficiently interact with external AI providers (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS, etc.). jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer (Agentic AI)
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **About Pramira**


Pramira is a California\-based engineering and construction company specializing in telecommunications, electrical, and infrastructure projects. We are hiring an AI Automation Engineer to join our team in India.

 **Job Description** **About the Role**


You will study how our teams work, find tasks that AI agents and automation can take over, and then build, deploy, and maintain those solutions. You will use free, open\-source, and existing Microsoft 365 tools wherever possible, running them on the cloud or on our own servers. This is a hands\-on role: you will own your solutions from idea to daily use.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review workflows with our operations, project, field, finance, and HR teams and find where AI can save time
* Build AI agents that can plan, use tools, and complete multi\-step business tasks
* Build an AI assistant that answers staff questions from our company procedures and policies (RAG)
* Automate construction tasks such as RFI drafting, document data extraction, bid screening, compliance reminders, and weekly reports
* Connect agents to Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate), Smartsheet, and other systems through APIs
* Deploy and run open\-source platforms such as n8n, LangGraph, CrewAI, and Ollama using Docker on Linux or cloud servers
* Monitor performance, fix issues, control costs, and keep sensitive data secure
* Document your work and train staff to use the tools

  

**Qualifications** **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years in software development or automation, including 1\+ year building LLM applications or AI agents
* Strong Python skills and experience with REST APIs
* Hands\-on experience with at least one agent framework (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or n8n)
* Experience with RAG and vector databases (Chroma, Qdrant, pgvector, or similar)
* Experience deploying applications with Docker on Linux and on at least one cloud platform
* Experience with both commercial LLM APIs and open\-source models run locally
* Good spoken and written English, and the ability to explain technical work to non\-technical staff

**Nice to Have**

* Power Automate, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, or Copilot Studio experience
* Smartsheet API experience
* Experience in construction, telecom, engineering, or field services
* OCR and data extraction from PDFs, drawings, and forms
* Experience working with US\-based teams

**What We Offer**

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid sick leave
* Direct work with company leadership on high\-impact projects
* Freedom to choose and build the tools that shape how the company runs

**Application Questions**

* Describe one AI agent or automation you built that people use regularly. What did it do?
* Which agent frameworks have you used in production?
* Have you run open\-source language models on your own server? Which ones?
* Can you work (X) hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time?
* What is your current and expected annual CTC, and your notice period?

  

**Additional Information**  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

**Location:** Ahmedabad (Currently Remote – Office reopening this year)

**Company:** Xeo Software

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About Xeo Software

Xeo Software is an AI\-first company with a 14\-member high\-performance team building enterprise\-grade AI systems for internal automation and client solutions. We focus on practical, scalable AI systems and not prototypes.

**Our Core Values Come First**

At Xeo Software, we believe skills can be taught, but values must be shared. To thrive here, you must not only be technically strong — you must live out the principles that define how we work together and with our clients.

**Two\-Way Candor**

We speak directly and respectfully, even when conversations are hard. We invite honest feedback and give it in return, knowing it strengthens trust and outcomes.

**Excellence \& Professionalism**

We take pride in doing things right the first time. That means going beyond “good enough” polishing details, documenting solutions, and holding ourselves to the highest standard.

**Continuous Learning**

Technology evolves fast, and so do we. We actively seek out new tools, share knowledge with teammates, and integrate innovations that drive better results.

**Loyalty to Team \& Clients**

We succeed together. We support one another, assume good intent, and show the same loyalty to our clients that we do to our coworkers.

If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel at home here. If not, no matter your technical skills, this isn’t the right place for you.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a **.NET Software Engineer (2–5 years experience)** to help develop and maintain our enterprise Professional Services Automation (PSA) platform and its associated automation and integration engine.

Our PSA platform is designed to govern service delivery operations, project execution, time tracking, and billing logic for professional service firms.

You will work directly with the product architecture team to build features across the platform including workflow orchestration, authorization logic, integrations, and operational reporting.

This role is ideal for developers who enjoy working on **complex business systems, backend architecture, and real\-world operational workflows.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Development**

* Design and implement backend features using **ASP.NET Core and C\#**
* Build APIs and business logic supporting Stratym’s operational modules (services, projects, tasks, billing)
* Contribute to the development of **our automation and integration platform**

**System Integration**

* Implement integrations with external platforms (CRM, accounting systems, messaging services)
* Develop secure API endpoints and webhook processing logic
* Support idempotent request handling and event\-driven integrations

**Data and Architecture**

* Work with **SQL Server** to design queries, stored procedures, and data models
* Implement business rules, authorization logic, and workflow state management
* Ensure high reliability, auditability, and operational correctness

**Platform Enhancements**

* Participate in feature development for:
* workflow orchestration
* time tracking and billing logic
* permissions and authorization
* automation scenarios

**Quality and Maintainability**

* Write clean, testable, and maintainable code
* Participate in peer code reviews
* Help improve platform performance and reliability

**Required Skills**

**Technical Skills**

* **2–5 years experience** in .NET development
* Strong experience with **C\# and ASP.NET Core**
* Experience with **SQL Server**
* Understanding of **REST APIs**
* Familiarity with **Entity Framework or Dapper**
* Knowledge of **JavaScript / front\-end frameworks** (basic level acceptable)

**Software Engineering**

* Understanding of **object\-oriented design principles**
* Experience working with **enterprise business applications**
* Ability to debug and troubleshoot complex issues
* Experience with **Git\-based version control**

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience building **workflow or automation systems**
* Experience with **multi\-tenant SaaS platforms**
* Familiarity with **authentication / authorization systems**
* Experience working with **Azure or cloud services**
* Exposure to **event\-driven architectures**

**What You’ll Work On**

**Developers on this team contribute to systems including:**

* Service lifecycle and workflow orchestration
* Project execution tracking
* Work item management and time tracking
* Billing and invoice generation logic
* Integration framework for external systems
* Automation platform

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on a **serious enterprise product**
* Exposure to **system architecture and platform design**
* Direct collaboration with product architects
* Long\-term product development environment (not contract work)

**2–5 years**

Education

* B.Tech / BE / MCA / equivalent in Computer Science or related field
